emojis.label: gaza activists report abuse
emojis.title: Seized on Their Way to Gaza, Activists Tell of Abuse in Israeli Custody
emojis.summary: In interviews, more than 20 people who tried to break an Israeli blockade described beatings, electric shocks and other abuse after being captured. Israel denied the accusations.

emojis.label: defense pact signed by three nations
emojis.title: Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan Sign Joint Defense Pact
emojis.summary: The agreement treats an attack on any of the countries as an attack on all, but in a region of volatile rivalries, it was unclear how it would work in practice.

emojis.label: thailand vows stricter gun laws
emojis.title: Thai PM vows to introduce stricter gun laws after eight killed in shooting
emojis.summary: Eight people were killed when a 14-year-old opened fire at his home and school before shooting himself dead.

emojis.label: rare eagle rescued and freed
emojis.title: Kidnapped rare Serbian eagle freed into wild after rescue
emojis.summary: Feliks the eagle was abducted as he first flew the nest in Serbia and wound up in the Middle East with poachers who demanded a ransom.

emojis.label: danube river reveals nazi vessels
emojis.title: A Drying Danube River Reveals Nazi-Era Vessels, and Hazards of Heat
emojis.summary: The river’s water levels have fallen as extreme heat has afflicted Europe, exposing sunken German vessels from World War II that are impeding navigation.
